What You Get

A backyard built for the whole party.

The point is not just a pool. It is a relaxed, flexible home base where kids can swim, adults can actually talk, and the party has room to shift from daytime hangs into night energy.

Pool + Hot Tub

Deep-end swimming, a heated hot tub, and a shallow tanning ledge that works well for toddlers and lounging.

Lawn + Games

Open grass, sand pit areas, and space for cornhole, bounce houses, games, and moving around.

Shade + Seating

Canopies, six-foot tables, cocktail tables, and foldable chairs give the day a real event setup.

Evening Glow

String lights and heaters help the backyard feel warm, useful, and intentional after sunset.

Kid Aware

The mesh pool fence can stay up for younger groups or come down when you want a more open layout.

Host Support

Fam Jam is onsite during events, helping the space run smoothly without turning it into a stiff venue.

Honest Details

What to know before you book.

Outdoor Space

This is a beautiful open-air backyard. Check the forecast and plan the flow around the weather.

Restrooms

Guests use indoor restrooms inside the home. It works well, but it is not a standalone event facility.

Parking

Street parking is available nearby. We have hosted larger groups without parking becoming the main problem.

Hosts Onsite

Your hosts are present during the event to help the space function and answer questions.

Pool Safety

The mesh safety fence is useful for younger parties and can be removed when the layout calls for it.

Neighborhood Flow

The setting is relaxed and residential, so we keep the party organized, respectful, and manageable.
